sim_name: Week 2: all-or-nothing, simulated options before earnings (PAPER TRADING, no real money)
user_request: Dmitry (2026-10-31): another week, this time 'no way you don't double the portfolio, do what it takes'; chose 'all-or-nothing: simulated options before earnings'. Doubling is NOT guaranteed.

goal.note: Aggressive aim, not a promise. Model estimate: ~10-15% chance of reaching $2,000; >50% chance of ending below $500.

broker.fill_model: BUY at the ask, SELL at the bid (full spread paid), no extra slippage
broker.quote_source: Yahoo Finance option chains (cookie+crumb) via yopt.py; may lag the exchange by a few minutes
broker.mark_to_market: positions valued at the bid minus sell commission (conservative liquidation value)

contract_filters.note: strike = nearest to target OTM %, then further OTM (cheaper) up to max_otm_pct until 1+ contract fits the play budget; none fits -> skip the play

rules: SIMULATION ONLY: no broker, no account, no real money, nothing is sent to anyone.
Instruments: long calls/puts only (no spreads, no shorting, no margin). Whole contracts, 100 shares each, $0.65 per contract commission each way.
Fills: BUY at ask, SELL at bid. Positions are valued at the bid minus sell commission.
4 plays, one per earnings report, all with the 2026-11-06 expiry: PLTR calls (Mon), AMD puts (Tue), ARM calls (Wed), AFRM calls (Thu).
Entry: at the 15:30 ET run on the report day (reports are after the close). Fallback: if that run is missed, enter in the 16:20 ET run on frozen closing quotes; after 16:45 ET the play is skipped.

Sizing: PLTR a fixed $360. AMD 40%, ARM 30%, AFRM 30% of the cash available at entry time (so proceeds of earlier plays roll forward). Strike nearest to the target OTM% (PLTR 14%, AMD 16%, ARM 17%, AFRM 15%; max 25%/28%/30%/28%), stepping further OTM if 1 contract does not fit; if nothing fits, skip.
Exit: every position is sold at the bid in the first run at or after 09:45 ET on the morning after the report (IV crush: never hold through the next day).
Take-profit backstop: at any run, if a position's bid value (net of commission) is >= 2.0x its cost (+100%), sell it all.
No premium stop-loss (the plan is all-or-nothing); the maximum loss per play is its cost.
Missed exits are executed by the next hourly run. Unspent cash stays idle (no other trading).
Goal lock: once equity >= $2,000, no new entries; remaining positions still exit by the rules.
No new entries on Friday. Friday after-close run closes everything (expired options settle at intrinsic value) and the simulation is FINISHED.
Benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold from the first run on Monday 09:45 ET with $1,000 (Friday 2026-10-30 close was 755.72).

earnings_calendar.source: Palantir IR; Yahoo calendarEvents (confirmed, not estimated)

plays.thesis: Long OTM call. Actual 1-day move beat the implied move in 12 of the last 17 prints, 63% positive reactions, last print +29.5% vs ±12% implied; analysts leaning 'beat and raise'. A bet, not an edge.
Long OTM put. Stock at record after a huge run: sell-the-news pattern (day-1 reaction positive only 3 of the last 8 prints). Contrarian bet; a gap up loses the whole premium.
Long OTM call. Washed-out stock (about -30% in a month, -54% from the 52-week high): oversold-bounce bet if guidance is fine.
Long OTM call. Momentum into the print (+4.8% in 5 days) and a historically big earnings mover. Wide spreads: cost is counted by buying at ask / selling at bid.

benchmark.rule: Hypothetical $1000 buy-and-hold of SPY from the Monday 09:45 ET run

reference_quotes_friday_close.note: Friday 2026-10-30 close, Nov-6 expiry, for planning only; real fills use live quotes
